author: John Hammond
description:
https://jh.live/blackhat-2026 || Hacker Summer Camp is the cybersecurity community's nickname for the massive gathering of hackers, researchers, and IT professionals every summer in Las Vegas -- with some of my favorite events and conferences like Black Hat USA!

Thanks to their support, my team will be attending Black Hat 2026, and we're stoked to see ya, hang out, and hack away. Personally, I'm really looking forward to the world premiere of the Midnight in the War Room documentary film -- they let me squeeze in to the show! You gotta attend Black Hat USA to catch the premiere, and all the speakers, briefings, networking opportunities and all of the awesome event experience that Black Hat has to offer. Seriously, it's a phenomenal, like, cybersecurity family reunion -- you gotta be there!

You can use my link below or the code HAMMOND to get $200 dollars off a Briefings Pass, or $100 dollars off a Business Pass. Huge thanks to @BlackHatOfficialYT  for partnering with us and helping
title: See you at Black Hat USA 2026!
